'''Sherk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], working as a customs officer in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where he was responsible for inspecting [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that arrived in the city. In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian|Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Cularin Office of Public Safety]] agent [[Ezra Du'Re]] traveled to Tolea Biqua and on arrival there, she met with Sherk, who informed her of how to get into contact with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Thook Lafrell]].
